UpdateDIAlarmRule.description_zh: 更新数据集成新版任务告警规则，当前支持的任务类型包括：MySQL到Hologres整库实时解决方案

UpdateDIJob.description_en: Updates a new-version synchronization task. The following type of task is supported: real-time synchronization of all data in a MySQL database to Hologres
UpdateDIJob.description_zh: 更新数据集成新版任务，当前支持的任务类型包括：MySQL到Hologres整库实时解决方案

UpdateDIProjectConfig.description_en: Modifies the default global configuration of synchronization solutions in a DataWorks workspace
UpdateDIProjectConfig.description_zh: 修改当前工作空间中数据集成同步解决方案任务默认的全局配置

UpdateDISyncTask.description_zh: 更新数据集成同步任务

UpdateDataServiceApi.description_en: Updates the information about an API in the development state in DataService Studio
UpdateDataServiceApi.description_zh: 调用UpdateDataServiceApi更新数据服务API开发态的信息

UpdateDataSource.description_zh: 该接口用于更新数据源

UpdateFile.description_zh: 调用UpdateFile更新已创建的文件

UpdateFolder.description_zh: 调用UpdateFolder更新文件夹的信息

UpdateIDEEventResult.description_en: Returns the check result of an extension point event to DataStudio after the extension point event is triggered during data development and checked by an extension
UpdateIDEEventResult.description_zh: 用于在数据开发过程中触发扩展点时，通过将扩展程序对扩展点事件的检查结果返回给数据开发系统

UpdateMetaCollection.description_en: Updates the name and comment of a collection
UpdateMetaCollection.description_zh: 该接口用于更新集合对象的名称和注释

UpdateMetaTable.description_en: This operation updates the metadata of a table
UpdateMetaTable.description_zh: 该接口用于更新表的Meta信息

UpdateMetaTableIntroWiki.description_en: Updates the instructions on how to use a table. If no instruction on how to use the table is available, the instructions that are configured by calling this operation are added
UpdateMetaTableIntroWiki.description_zh: 该接口用于更新表的说明信息，当数据不存在时增加信息

UpdateNodeOwner.description_en: Changes the owner of a node
UpdateNodeOwner.description_zh: 调用UpdateNodeOwner接口修改目标节点的负责人

UpdateNodeRunMode.description_en: Freezes or unfreezes a specified node
UpdateNodeRunMode.description_zh: 调用UpdateNodeRunMode接口冻结或解冻目标节点

UpdateQualityRule.description_en: Calls UpdateQualityRule to update the information of a quality check rule
UpdateQualityRule.description_zh: 调用UpdateQualityRule更新校验规则的信息

UpdateRemind.description_zh: 调用UpdateRemind更新自定义监控规则

UpdateTableAddColumn.description_en: Updates the fields in a MaxCompute table

UpdateTableLevel.description_en: Updates a hierarchy level. This operation will be replaced soon. We recommend that you do not call this operation
UpdateTableLevel.description_zh: 调用UpdateTableLevel更新层级。不建议使用该API，后续将有新API上线覆盖此功能

UpdateTableModelInfo.description_en: Modifies the information about a table, such as the table folder, level, and category
UpdateTableModelInfo.description_zh: 修改表的主题、层级和物理分类等信息

UpdateTableTheme.description_en: Updates a table theme. This operation will be replaced soon. We recommend that you do not call this operation
UpdateTableTheme.description_zh: 调用UpdateTableTheme更新主题。不建议使用该API，后续将有新API上线覆盖此功能

UpdateUdfFile.description_en: Updates the file information of a function
UpdateUdfFile.description_zh: 调用UpdateUdfFile更新函数的文件信息

UpdateWorkbenchEventResult.description_en: Returns the processing result sent by an extension after a process in Operation Center is blocked by the extension
UpdateWorkbenchEventResult.description_zh: 所属扩展程序的运维中心回调API，当运维中心的流程被扩展程序卡住后,调用UpdateWorkbenchEventResult返回扩展程序的处理结果
